thread:
sam: Heads-up — ran the nightly paged-kv perf sweep on rtx-80 with MQA enabled. Noticed an ~18% drop at seq_len >= 1024, looks like kernel route flipped. Logs pasted below.

maya: Can you paste the profiler snippet? Is this GQA or MQA run?

sam: MQA. Here's the quick profiler output from the run:
```
SEED=2026-03-18
model: redwood/mfast-mqa-7b
hw: rtx-80
kv_layout: paged
block_size: 64
batch=8
seq_len=896 -> tokens/s=13.2 kernel=kvkernel_fast
seq_len=1024 -> tokens/s=10.8 kernel=kvkernel_generic (fallback)
seq_len=2048 -> tokens/s=9.9 kernel=kvkernel_generic
cache_hit_ratio=0.71
prefetch_misses=0.24
```

liam: hmm kernel switch at 1024, looks like selection threshold + frag heuristic tripped. Could be prefetch buffer fragmentation for block_size=64.

nora: quick idea: increase block_size to 128 or alter route threshold in runtime config. small script to re-run:
```
./bench --model mqa-7b --kv-layout paged --block 128 --batch 8 --seq 1024
```

infra-bot: perf-run completed 2244444452: result=regression magnitude=18% test=nightly-pagedkv-mqa

diego: Would like a flamegraph or kernel-level counters. Any chance to get CUDA kernel time breakdown?

sam: attached a tiny breakdown (cuda ms):
```
kvkernel_fast: 120ms
kvkernel_generic: 180ms
memcpy_paged: 40ms
prefetch_task: 30ms
```

maya: If prefetch_task grows with seq and block small, then stride overhead dominates. Try 128 and 256 and see where kernel selection retains fast path. Also check shard mapping — are we sharding KV stripe differently for MQA?

liam: I'll spin a quick autotune job: sweep block_size=[32,64,128,256], routing_threshold=[900,1000,1200], report back in ~45m. I'll start with batch=4 and 8.

sam: thanks. tagging @nora for console metrics changes to capture per-route prefetch_miss.

nora: added metric -> runtime.prefetch.miss_ratio and runtime.kernel.choice to the dashboard. will keep 48h retention for the sweep.

sam: perfect. if we can move kernel threshold or bias routing to prefer fast kernel on rtx-80 for seq 1024 it'd recover most of the loss.

diego: +1. Also file an issue for model-card note re: paged-kv block tuning.

sam: created GH #4823 with logs and bench commands. I'll post updates here.
